description: This source file defines a utility enum SystemPresenceInfo with static methods to retrieve system presence information such as the time since the last input event and the primary IPv4 address. It interacts with system APIs related to events and network interfaces.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds elapsed since the last user input event, or nil if the information cannot be determined or is invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IPv4 address of the system via the NetworkInterfaces utility.
